name: Self-Transcendence 2 mailin juoksu, Vaasa
description: Self-Transcendence 2 mile run in Vaasa is held every Tuesday from May to September at 7:00 PM at Hietalahti Peace Meadow. The route is a 1-mile park course, run twice. The start and registration are located behind the swimming hall. The run offers a quick and pleasant park route suitable for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 1-mile park course
Route is run twice
Start and registration behind the swimming hall
additional: The runs are organized every Tuesday from May to September. The competition features several categories for different age groups. Results are available from previous years. The organizer is the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which has served the running community for over 35 years. The event takes place every Tuesday at 7:00 PM until September, and the participation fee is not specified.

name: Valon Kymppi
description: Valon Kymppi is a 10 km running event held in the autumn in Jyväskylä. The late start time, the darkening evening, and the city lights along the Rantaraitti create a unique atmosphere for the run. The route has been awarded as Finland's most beautiful traffic route, is flat and fast, and the event center is Jyväskylän Paviljonki.
course_highlights: Late start time and evening atmosphere
City lights along Rantaraitti
Awarded as Finland's most beautiful traffic route
Flat and fast route
Event center at Jyväskylän Paviljonki

Valon Kymppi - Jyväskylän reittikartta. 10km juoksu Rantaraitilla.

name: Finlandia Marathon
description: Finlandia Marathon is a running event held in Jyväskylä on September 11–12, 2026. The course is the Jyväskylä Rantaraitti, recognized as Finland's most beautiful traffic route, flat and fast. The event center is located at Lutakonaukio and Jyväskylän Paviljonki.
course_highlights: The course is the Jyväskylä Rantaraitti, recognized as Finland's most beautiful traffic route
Flat and fast course
Event center at Lutakonaukio and Jyväskylän Paviljonki

images.alt_text: Finlandia Marathonin lähtö Jyväskylässä. Juoksijat starttaavat.

name: Finlandia Vitonen
description: Finlandia Vitonen is the shortest distance at the Finlandia Marathon, and it is aimed at everyone interested in physical activity. Participants can move at their own pace, whether it's a brisk sprint or a leisurely walk. The route, which is 5 km long, runs along Jyväskylä's Rantaraitti, and the start takes place at Lutakko Square. The event also features encouraging and fun activities at the start and finish areas as well as along the route.
course_highlights: The route is 5 km long along Jyväskylä's Rantaraitti.
Start at Lutakko Square.
Participants can walk or run at their own pace.
Event includes fun and encouraging activities at start, finish, and along the route.

images.alt_text: Finlandia Vitonen -juoksussa osallistujia. Hyvä kuvaus kilpailusta.

name: Matin Muistokymppi
description: Matin Muistokymppi is a running event held on September 5, 2024, in Lieksa. The competition offers participants the opportunity to run a 10-kilometer course in beautiful scenery, and the route is designed to be both challenging and enjoyable for runners of all levels. The event is especially aimed at fitness enthusiasts and running fans, providing an excellent opportunity to enjoy the outdoors and good company. Participants can run or walk, and times are recorded for all interested.

images.alt_text: Juoksijat lähtevät juoksukilpailuun, jossa on paljon osallistujia.
Juoksukilpailu käynnissä, kilpailijat juoksevat märällä asfaltilla.
Ryhmä ihmisiä kävelemässä tai juoksemassa ulkona.

name: Finlandiaviesti
location: Jyväskylä, Rantaraitti, Jyväskylä, Central Finland, Finland
description: Finlandiaviesti 1/2026 is part of the Finlandia Marathon event, which will be held in Jyväskylä on September 11-12, 2026. The event offers runners a variety of distances, including 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and marathon, suitable for all levels of runners. The course runs along Jyväskylä's Rantaraitti, awarded as Finland's most beautiful traffic route, providing a flat and fast running experience. The Finlandia Marathon is known for its runner-friendly route, excellent atmosphere, and an event weekend full of experiences in the beautiful landscapes of Central Finland.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course along Jyväskylä's Rantaraitti
Route awarded as Finland's most beautiful traffic route
Water stations along the route and tables reserved for own drinks
additional: There are water stations along the route, and tables are reserved for participants' own drinks at the stations. Students receive a €10 discount on the participation fee (€5 for Finlandia Vitosella). With an S-Etukortti or Juoksijakortti, a €4 discount is available on the participation fee. Cancellation insurance is included for registrations made by May 31, after which the cancellation fee is €5. The event includes relay races, marathon, half marathon, and shorter runs, offering participants the opportunity to enjoy the beautiful environment and a good atmosphere.

name: Laajavuori Trail Run
description: Welcome to the Laajavuori Trail Run mountain trail running event in Jyväskylä's Laajavuori on Saturday, September 13, 2025! This adrenaline-pumping event offers stunning routes in the heart of Central Finland's nature – hills, forests, roots, and breathtaking scenery. Whether you're an experienced veteran or just starting out, Laajavuori Trail Run is the perfect way to challenge yourself and enjoy nature while moving.
course_highlights: Stunning routes through Central Finland's natural landscape
Varied terrain including hills, forests, and roots
Suitable for both experienced runners and beginners

images.alt_text: Suomen lippu ja kaunis luontomaisema metsässä ja järvellä.

name: Kaisaniemen Juoksu
description: Kaisaniemi Run will be held on Saturday, September 13, 2025, with distances of 5 km and 21.1 km. Pre-registration for the 2025 event is now open – sign up now! The start point for both distances is located a few minutes' walk from the Eläintarha field on Hammarskjöldintie. The routes are officially measured according to WA standards.

images.alt_text: Nainen juoksee hämärän aikaan. Hyvä kuva juoksusta.

name: Ruskamaraton
description: The Fall Marathon is held for the 42nd time in a row, and the event day is the second Saturday of September, that is, September 13, 2025. This event for sports, Lapland, and joy lovers has been part of the local culture since 1984. The Fall Marathon offers participants the opportunity to compete over a distance of 42.195 km in different age groups.

images.alt_text: Ruskamaratonin juoksijoita Levillä. Upeat maisemat ja paljon osallistujia.
Ruskamaratonin juoksijoita Levillä. Hyvälaatuinen kuva kilpailusta.
Ruskamaratonin reittikartat ja aikataulut Levillä. Selkeät kartat ja aikataulu.

name: Tahko Trail Run
organizer: Kuopio-Tahko Markkinointi Oy ja TAHKOcom Oy
description: Tahko Trail Run is a new trail running event held in the stunning scenery of Tahkovuori on September 12, 2026. The event offers four different distance options suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The routes pass through natural and varied terrains with challenging ascents and breathtaking views. The event emphasizes an experiential atmosphere, a lively ambiance, well-marked routes, and aid stations. At the finish area, there is a race atmosphere, food, and the opportunity to enjoy a sauna and shower at Break Sokos Hotel Tahko.
course_highlights: 8.5 km route includes Tahko's most beautiful natural sights and scenery, also suitable for walking
14 km route offers challenge and experiences, with approximately 370 meters of elevation gain
23 km route is demanding and rewarding, passing Rahasmäki trails and including the legendary Tahko stairs, with approximately 650 meters of elevation gain
additional: The routes are well marked, and there are multiple aid stations offering water, sports drinks, fruits, and salty snacks. Participants should bring their own cup or water bottle as drinks are only available in personal containers. At the finish, participants receive a medal as a memento, and there are light snacks and drinks available at the finish area. Food is served at Break Sokos Hotel Tahko in the form of a pasta buffet. Participants have the opportunity to use the hotel’s shower and sauna. Bib pickup and information points are located at Hophaus Tahko, next to the event area. The cloakroom operates as a self-service without continuous supervision. There are plenty of parking spaces, most of which are paid; a free parking area is available next to Tahko Bay beach, about a 10-minute walk from the event area. The routes are well marked, and the event includes beverage service, food at Break Sokos Hotel Tahko (pasta buffet), shower, and sauna at the hotel. Participation is also possible for children and families.

name: SaaristoTrail
description: SaaristoTrail is an exciting trail running event in Parainen, offering varied routes in the beautiful archipelago nature. The event features three main distances: 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km half marathon, suitable for both beginners and more experienced trail runners. The routes include diverse trails, gravel paths, and significant elevation changes, such as steep ascents of Svinövuori, providing unforgettable scenery and challenge. The relaxed atmosphere and careful organization make it a pleasant experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Varied trails and gravel paths
Steep ascents of Svinövuori and refreshments at the summit
Approximately 850 meters of total elevation gain on the 21 km route
additional: The 1 km children's run is free for pre-registered participants (last registration date September 10) and costs 5 euros for late registrations. All participants in the children's run receive a medal. The race center is located at the Finby ski stadium, which also has shower facilities at Archipelagia Golf's dressing rooms. The route is marked with red and white plastic ribbons. Race materials can be picked up at the race office starting at 8:45 AM and until half an hour before your start. At the finish line, juice and water are available, and the results are posted on an information board. Late registration at the event site is available via MobilePay or bank card, cash is not accepted. The event includes various route options, and participants can choose the suitable distance. The routes and results can be found on the event's website, and the event offers an opportunity to enjoy the natural beauty of the archipelago and the joy of movement.

name: Bladhin Loppet
description: Bladhin run returns and we will organize a race on September 13, 2025. This historic running event takes place through the beautiful wooden house scenery of Kaskinen and offers participants an unforgettable experience. The competition includes several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, Children's run (500 m), and Walker's run (150 m).
course_highlights: Runs through the scenic wooden house area of Kaskinen
Includes multiple race distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, Children's run, and Walker's run

name: Kohnan Lenkki
description: Kohnan Lenkki 2023 takes place on September 16, 2023, and features several categories for different age groups. The event includes running distances of various lengths, such as 0.8 km for children and 9.8 km for adults. There are separate categories for girls, boys, women, and men, allowing everyone to participate in a suitable race. The event is held in an area called Kohna in Satakunta Panelia, through which the Eurajoki river flows.

images.alt_text: Kohnan Lenkki -juoksukilpailun logo, jossa on lintuja oranssilla taustalla.

name: Kaljamaili SM-kisa
description: Peräkylän Ponnistus organizes the Beer Mile Finnish Championship on Friday, August 26th at 6:00 PM at the central field of Pirkkola Sports Park. The rules are simple: run a mile, which is four laps around the track, and before each lap, enjoy one beer. The fastest to finish wins. The competition has two categories: Beer (Official) and Non-Alcoholic Beer, and the categories are unisex. The world record according to international rules is 4:33.6.

images.alt_text: Kolme ihmistä yleisurheiluradalla, yksi heistä viittoo.

name: Tampere Maraton 13.9.2026
description: The Tampere Marathon is an authentic city marathon held in the heart of Tampere on September 13, 2026. The event offers a marathon, half marathon, 10 km race, a mini marathon for the youngest participants, and a marathon relay for teams of four. The route runs through the city center and along Tampere's waterways, mainly on asphalt and partly on gravel paths, offering beautiful urban scenery and a challenge for runners. The start and finish areas are located at Tampere Stadium, which is easily accessible. The event is organized from runner to runner and provides a sense of achievement for runners of all ages and levels.
course_highlights: The route runs through the city center and along Tampere's waterways
Mainly asphalt and partly gravel paths, a verified route
Two aid stations approximately 3-4 km apart and toilet facilities at aid stations
additional: Race office open on Saturday, September 12 from 16:00 to 19:00 and on Sunday, September 13 from 08:00 at Tampere Stadium. The 10 km start is at Aleksandra Siltanen Park, about 2 km from the stadium; allow 20 minutes for travel to the start. Changing rooms and gear storage are available at Tampere Stadium. Marathon pacers run target times of 3:45 (uncertain), 4:00, 4:15, 4:30, and 5:00. At the finish line, warm soup, juice, and water are offered. Timing and results service provided by MyLaps Sports Service. Front-wheel pacers ensure unobstructed passage for leading runners. Traffic control on the route in cooperation with the police. The event takes place on September 13, 2026; registration is open online; various categories and distances are available; participants can access race services and route instructions; discounts with the Runner Card and the option to transfer participation with a medical certificate.

name: Ruskahölkkä
distance_verbose: 7 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km, 0.3 km, 0.1 km
description: The Running Race is a versatile trail running event in Oulainen, offering categories and distances for runners of all ages and fitness levels. The competition is held at the Honkamaja area and includes distances from 0.3 km for children to 10 km for general categories, as well as fitness series. Prizes are awarded in each category, and there are also raffles, such as a bicycle giveaway. Runners have access to showered changing rooms, and the event is part of Oulaisten Taru's diverse sports activities.
course_highlights: Versatile distances from children to adults 0.3 km - 10 km
Fitness series 5 km and 10 km
Showered changing rooms for women and men
additional: Late registrations are charged at double the fee. Prizes are awarded to at least the top three in each category, and all participants in the under 12 age groups receive prizes. Prizes are also raffled among fitness series participants. All runners participate in a bicycle raffle. The competition includes various distances such as 0.1 km, 0.3 km, 0.5 km, 1 km, 2 km, 5 km, and 7 km, and is a popular local event offering the opportunity to participate in outdoor running.

name: Hiekkojen Herruus Trail Run
description: Hiekkojen Herruus Trail Run offers fast and moderately challenging routes in the beautiful pine forests and seaside scenery of Kalajoki. The course runs along winding needle paths and includes technically demanding sections that test the runner's fitness and skills. The event is part of a two-day festival, which also includes MTB races or combined competitions. Welcome to experience the unique atmosphere of Kalajoki's sandy terrains and challenge yourself!
course_highlights: Winding needle paths in pine forests
Seaside scenery
Technically demanding sections
additional: Number bib distribution begins at 9:00 AM at the competition center. There is a bike washing station, changing rooms, showers, and a sauna at the event site. During the event weekend, participants can purchase a discounted spa ticket to Sanifani (adults €14, children €8). Participation is at your own risk; a valid liability insurance is recommended. The event includes trail run and MTB races, various age groups, the race day schedule, and registration instructions. Participants can also enjoy the saunas and showers at the competition site.

name: Lasse Virén Hölkkä
description: The 53rd International Lasse Virén Jogging will be held in Myrskylä on Sunday, September 13, 2026, at 12:00 PM. The event offers several distances, including road running 10.3 km, half marathon 21.1 km, as well as a fitness series and a hike/pole walk/jog 6 km. Welcome to join Lasse's Jogging!
course_highlights: Road running 10.3 km
Half marathon 21.1 km
Fitness series
Hike/pole walk/jog 6 km

Lasse Virén hölkkä -juoksija maastossa. Hyvälaatuisen kuvan.
Juoksija Lasse Virén hölkkä -kisassa.  Kaunis maalaismaisema.

name: Visahölkkä
description: Visahölkkä is a traditional running event held in the rural landscape of Ojakkala on the first Sunday of October. The first Visahölkkä was run in the fall of 2007, and the number of participants has stabilized between 30 and 50 runners. The event offers several different distances suitable for runners of all ages and skill levels, and it is part of the Vihdin Hölkkäkunkku series.

images.alt_text: Visahölkkä-juoksukilpailun kuva. Kaksi juoksijaa juoksee maastossa.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu
description: Forssan Puistojuoksu is an event that has been held since 1985 and has attracted runners for 30 years. The park run, held once a month, always features 100-200 runners of various ages, and the beautiful route winds through the scenery of the Loimijoki River. Runners can choose between a 5.8 km or 11.2 km route, which passes around the outskirts of Forssa's city center in the old cotton factory park. The start and finish are located on Keskuskatu, in front of the over a hundred-year-old Elävät kuvat cinema.

images.alt_text: Puistojuoksussa osallistujia nauttimassa liikunnasta kauniissa maisemassa.
Puistojuoksun kausikortti 2024. Juoksijoita ja kuukauden päivämäärät.

name: Tammimäki Juoksu
description: Tammimäki Juoksu is held for the second time on Sunday, September 8th at 2:00 PM in Pappinen. The course length is 10.7 km and includes many elevation changes. The race has two categories (Men and Women), and the top three in each category will be awarded cash prizes (€100, €60, and €40). The participation fee is €10, and registration takes place at the race center located at Vartiamäentie 15, Pappinen.

images.alt_text: Juoksukilpailu, jossa osallistujat juoksevat märällä asfaltilla.

name: Gennarbyviken Runt
description: Gennarbyviken Runt is a beautiful gravel road course that circles Gennarbyviken. This year, a half marathon was held for the first time, and the Kero brothers ran the race at a brisk pace, with Jaakko Kero winning in a time of 1:13:42. There were a total of 64 participants, which is fewer than the previous year. Gennarbyviken Runt has been a popular event for over 60 years.

images.alt_text: Juoksija Gennarbyviken Runt -kilpailussa juoksee soratiellä, numero 115.

name: Arctic Trail Run
description: Arctic Trail Run is a trail running event held on the mountain trails of Saariselkä in Urho Kekkonen National Park. This event offers a unique opportunity to explore stunning scenery where mountain cliffs blend with thick moss. Participants will enjoy varied routes and challenging weather conditions, making each running day an unforgettable experience.

images.alt_text: Polkujuoksu Saariselän tunturimaisemissa. Juoksijat nousevat mäkeä ylös, vuoristo ja järvi taustalla.
Maisemakuva Arctic Trail Runin reitiltä, tuntureita ja taivas.
Juoksija tunturimaisemassa, jossa on matalaa kasvillisuutta ja sininen taivas.
Polkujuoksija juoksee puusillalla metsäpolulla, jossa on paljon vihreää kasvustoa.

name: NGS Unrestricted Duathlon
description: Unrestricted Duathlon is a new event in the NGS calendar, combining cross-country skiing and gravel riding. This event offers a great opportunity to explore the beautiful autumn scenery and forests. The event options are Half Marathon - 21 km (4 km cross-country skiing + 13 km gravel + 4 km cross-country skiing), Marathon - 42 km (6 km cross-country skiing + 30 km gravel + 6 km cross-country skiing), and Ultra - 84 km (12 km cross-country skiing + 60 km gravel + 12 km cross-country skiing). The event will be held at Pajulahti on September 20-21, 2025.

name: Velo Salo Backyard Ultra
description: Velo Salo Backyard Ultra race course is mostly on forest roads, but also includes approximately 250 meters of more challenging trail section and an easier about 400-meter sand/asphalt segment. The course is run clockwise and is 6.7 km long, with start times for new laps every hour. The competition continues as long as there is only one runner remaining, but unfortunately, the organizers must end the race after 36 laps if no winner has been found after running over 240 km.

images.alt_text: Kokoelma kuvia Velo Salo -juoksukilpailusta, juoksijoita ja tapahtuman nimi näkyvissä.
Pyöräilijöitä Velo Salo -tapahtumassa, jossa osallistujilla on kilpailun nimi paidassa.

name: Ruissalojuoksut
description: Experience beautiful nature and fresh autumn air at Ruissalo Runs on September 19th. Ruissalo Runs is a popular running event held in the scenic surroundings of Ruissalo Island. The event offers runners the opportunity to participate in various distances, such as the half marathon and 10-kilometer run, with routes passing through picturesque environments known for their diverse landscapes. This event attracts both amateurs and competitive athletes, and it is an excellent opportunity to enjoy running and nature.

images.alt_text: Ruissalojuoksujen kartta: lähtö, maali, pysäköinti ja muut tärkeät kohdat.

name: Aulanko Tower Trail
description: Aulanko Tower Trail is a trail running race in the breathtaking national landscape of Häme. Both routes will surely challenge the competitors: over the longer distance, a total of 550 meters of elevation gain is accumulated, and even on the shorter route, over 350 meters are climbed. The route options of 22 km and 13 km take the runner into the beautiful national scenery of Aulanko, and the framework of the Trail Tour Finland sub-competition makes the Aulanko Tower Trail an exciting race experience for every runner!

images.alt_text: Aulanko Tower Trailin lähtö. Juoksijat valmistautuvat kilpailuun.
Aulanko Tower Trail -juoksukilpailun mainoskuva. Vuorenrinteessä juoksevia siluetteja ja Aulangon torni.
Aulangon Tornin Polku -juoksun maaliintulo. Juoksija ylittää maaliviivan.

name: Renforsin maraton, Kajaani
description: Renforsin Marathon is a charity running event held in Kajaani on September 19, 2026, with proceeds supporting local youth sports. The event offers a stunning course along the beautiful river scenery and sights of Kajaani, such as near the ruins of Kajaani Castle. The start and finish areas are at the Market Square, and the route runs along the banks of the Kajaani River. The event includes a marathon, half marathon, quarter marathon, and children's runs for different age groups.
course_highlights: The route runs along the banks of the Kajaani River
Near the ruins of Kajaani Castle on the route
The route includes approximately 80 meters of total elevation gain and is about 60% hard-packed gravel and 40% asphalt
additional: Children's runs are free of charge, and participants are awarded. Mini-Renforsin runs for children under 8 years old (150 m) and over 8 years old (300 m) are without timing. There are three refreshment points on the route (at 3.5 km, 7.0 km, 10.5 km) with sports drinks and water. Participant materials can be picked up at the race office on Friday from 17:00 to 19:00 or on race day from 9:00 onwards. The awards ceremony for the top three in each category will be at 15:00 at the Market Square. The Oktoberfest tent opens at 16:00. The event is a charity event supporting youth sports, offering participants the chance to enjoy the beautiful environment and a communal atmosphere.

name: Kyröö-hölkkä 19.9.2026
description: Kyröö Run is a relaxed running event held in the beautiful rural landscapes of Isonkyrö. The event offers suitable distances for both casual joggers and more vigorous runners, and the race also awards unofficial Finnish championship medals in gravel running. The start takes place at Kyrön Visitor Center, and the route passes through varied but flat terrain. Come and experience the joy of exercise in good company and run where the asphalt ends!
course_highlights: The route passes through the rural landscapes of Isonkyrö in varied but flat terrain
Jauri 15 km route includes a water station approximately 7 kilometers into the race
Palonkylä 5 km route goes through Jaurintie, Taavetintie, Palonkyläntie, and Perttiläntie
additional: Participation fees include water stations, finish line refreshments, a participation gift (Sugar Daddies honey jar), and access to the swimming hall Pärske for showering, which is 2.6 km away. Fees can also be paid with sports vouchers (Smartum, Edenred, Epassi) according to email instructions. After the event, there is an option for a buffet meal at Kyrön Visitor Center. Parking is available at Kyrön Maatalousmuseo. The event requires prior registration and includes any applicable participation fee and insurance. Participants may also be involved in taking photos and videos for event marketing.

name: Ylivieska Trail Run – Meleko hyvä polokujuoksutapahtuma
description: Ylivieska Trail Run is a trail running event held on Saturday, September 19, 2026, at Törmälä Camping Center and Rantakallas in Ylivieska. The event offers competitive categories for men and women on a 14-kilometer course, as well as fitness and recreational categories on 1.5 km, 5 km, and 11 km distances. There are also prizes in the youth categories, and a free stadium dash for the youngest children. All participants will be entered into a draw to win an extended weekend at Jäkälähovi in Kalajoki. The event is diverse and suitable for trail runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Trail running in the Törmälä Camping Center and Rantakallas area
Competitive category 14 km distance for men and women
Fitness and recreational categories 1.5 km, 5 km, and 11 km
additional: Prizes and trophies are awarded in the youth categories. Youth race distances: Boys and girls 16 years old 5 km, boys and girls 12 years old 1.5 km, boys and girls 9 years old 1.5 km are free of charge. The stadium dash for children aged 1-6 years, approximately 200 meters, is free. All participants are entered into a draw to win an extended weekend at Jäkälähovi in Kalajoki. Various race categories, trail terrain, registration details, free events for children.

name: HOKA Messilä Vertical

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ilmoittautuminen päättyy 30.7. Hinnat viimeisen maksuportaan mukaan.

description: HOKA Messilä Vertical is a unique race where participants compete to accumulate the most elevation meters within a given time. The race takes place at Messilä Ski Resort in Hollola, and participants run a 1.2 km course with approximately 90 meters of ascent and descent per lap. The competition has three categories with durations of 1, 2, or 4 hours, and the winner is the one who completes the most laps in their category. The event is open to all ages, and the atmosphere is relaxed yet challenging, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: 1.2 km long course with about 90 meters of elevation gain and loss per lap
The course mainly runs on groomed ski slopes and grass areas at the competition center
The number of laps completed determines the winner, not the total time
additional: At the competition center, there is a hydration station and an official support area where competitors can have their own supporter. Messilä Hotel's sauna is available for competitors from 11:00 to 15:00 after the race for relaxation. A rough-textured trail or spiked shoes are recommended, especially in wet conditions. There is no minimum or maximum age limit for participation. The event is held at Messilä Ski Resort and includes access to sauna and dining options after the race. The race is aimed at mountain sports and trail running enthusiasts who want to challenge themselves with elevation changes.

name: Pentin Hölkkä
description: Pentin Hölkkä is a family outdoor event held on September 28, 2024, starting at 12:00 PM at the new outdoor shelter of the village association located at Sammallammintie 480. The event features a 5.2 km loop on sandy paths, with registration beginning at 12:00 PM. The race with a shared start is at 2:00 PM, but participants can join at their own pace without timing. The participation fee is €5, and a short run for children is organized around the shelter area.

name: Kansallinen Kymppi
description: The National Ten Thousand is run at Lahti Stadium on Saturday, September 20, 2025. Come run the track ten thousand or watch Finland's top ten thousand runners perform up close. The event features recreational runners, juniors, and the national elite – this is an event for all running enthusiasts, where you can challenge yourself in a 10,000-meter track run. The National Ten Thousand offers a unique opportunity to run an official 10,000-meter track race, and the evening culminates in a showdown among the national elite.

name: Oulun Academy Run
description: The 57th Oulu Run and the 7th Academy Run will be held on Saturday, September 16, 2023, with the race center located in Raatinsaari. The running route passes through Pikisaaren, Hietasaaren, Toppilansaaren, Möljän Sillan, Toppilan rannan, Merijalin Rannan, Patosillan, and Ainolan Park before reaching the finish line at Raatin Stadium. The distance is officially measured at 10 km, and participants will receive refreshments as well as free entry to the Raatin swimming hall after the event upon presenting their participation number.

name: Espoo Rantamaraton
description: Welcome to run the Espoo Rantamarathon - beautiful routes along the coast of Espoo city. On Saturday, September 20th, you can participate in the marathon (42.195 km), half marathon (21.1 km), 10K (10 km), 5K (5 km timed run), Aalto walk (5 km walk/run without timing), or children's run (1K/600 m).

name: Kullervo Marathon
description: Kullervo Marathon 2025 will be held in Joutseno on September 21, 2025. This event is known for its fast course, where several Finnish records, seasonal top domestic times, and personal bests have been achieved. For example, last September Ole Halonen ran the men's season top domestic time of 2:24:26 in Joutseno.

name: Kullervo-maraton 2026
location: Joutsenen urheilukeskus, Joutsenon, Lappeenranta, South Karelia, Finland
description: Kullervo Marathon 2026 will be held at Joutsenon Sports Center on Sunday, September 20, 2026. The event is traditional and offers Finland's fastest marathon route, which is almost completely asphalted and flat. The competition includes a marathon, half marathon, 10 km, and a children's mini marathon, making it suitable for runners of all levels. The route is well marked and there are enough aid stations. Participants will receive route support, a medal, coffee, a bun, and a hot meal at the race restaurant.
course_highlights: The route is almost completely asphalted and practically flat, except for a small incline at the transition section
Running distances are marked every 3 km with color-coded kilometer signs
There are two aid stations approximately every 4 km along the route, with an additional aid station on the first lap for the half marathon
additional: Race office is located at Joutsenohalli and is open on Saturday, September 19 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on Sunday, September 20 from 8:30 to 17:00. Race numbers are picked up from the race office. The maximum time to complete the marathon is 6 hours; there is no time limit for the half marathon and 10 km. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at Joutsenohalli. Free supervised baggage storage is available next to the race office. Late registration is possible at the race office on Saturday, September 19 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on Sunday, September 20 from 8:30, ending one hour before the start of each race. Payment at the race office is only by card or MobilePay. Participation can be transferred to the next year with a health certificate or to another person no later than September 17, 2026. Registration is online, and the participation fee includes route support, a medal, coffee, a bun, and a hot meal. The marathon is intended for participants over 18 years old, and no pre-registration is required for the children's mini marathon. On race day, late registration and the possibility to transfer participation to another year with a health certificate are also available.

name: KOMIA Kyrkösjärven kierros
description: KOMIA Kyrkösjärvi Circuit is Seinäjoki's legendary and popular running event, where participants run around Kyrkösjärvi. The event takes place at Kyrkösjärvi beach and Luontotalo Käpälikkö, which serve as the start, finish, parking, and event center. The main race is a 15.4 km route, with additional options including a shorter approximately 4.3 km Pikku Kyrkkäri for youth or jogging, and Mini Kyrkkäri 400-500 m for the youngest family members. The event offers an experiential running experience in nature and is open to different age and category groups.
course_highlights: 15.4 km route around Kyrkösjärvi
One water station approximately halfway along the route, offering water and sports drinks
Start, finish, and event center in the same location at Kyrkösjärvi beach
additional: Number bib pickup and registration at the event office from 9:30 to 10:45. Runners start in mass start at the same time. Mini Kyrkkäri begins at 11:10. Equipment storage and transport at the finish area. Catering at the event center. Clothing and toilets at the beach changing rooms. Participants receive a commemorative medal. Littering in nature is prohibited. Participation is at your own risk; a leisure-time insurance is recommended. First aid at the finish area and water stations. The event includes multiple distances and age groups, with registration available online or on-site. The course consists of natural trails and is held annually in September at Kyrkösjärvi.

name: Juutuanvaaran kymppi – polkujuoksu Inarissa 2026
location: Juutunvaaran vanha metsä, Inari, Lapland, Finland
description: Juutuanvaaran ten-kilometer is a new trail running event in Inari that offers experiential trails of various lengths for all runners. The route passes through the old forest of Juutuanvaara, featuring diverse terrain from pine-covered plains to mountain birch forests and a stunning view of Lake Inari. The race starts on September 20, 2026, at 12:00 PM, and participants will receive honorary awards and commemorative medals. The event is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners, and participants will be served race sausage and a drink.
course_highlights: 159 m elevation gain, 354 m ascent
Pine-covered plains and mountain birch forests
Magnificent view of Lake Inari
additional: Children's adventure trail 0.5 - 1 km. Honorary awards for the best in main categories. Commemorative medal for all participants. The participation fee includes a race sausage and a drink. Elevation gain 159 m, 354 m ascent, pine-covered plains, mountain birch forests, view of Lake Inari.

name: Bockabroloppet
description: IK Falken organizes BOCKABROLOPPET on Sunday, September 21, 2025, at 11:00 AM, starting and finishing at Pedersören Eräkeskus, Teerijärventie 110, 68840 Lappfors. The race features several categories: Girls/Boys under 12 years 1.5 km, under 14 years 2.5 km, as well as for adults 14 km and mountain bike category 28 km. Intermissions and amenities such as toilets, showers, and sauna are available at the race site.

name: Nuuksio Night Trail
description: Petzl Nuuksio Night Trail 2026 will be held on September 25, 2026! The event center is located at Luukin Outdoor Cabin, Luukintie 33 (next to Luukin Manor). The route is approximately 13 kilometers long and runs near Nuuksio National Park. All runners are required to have a headlamp, as the event takes place in the dark forest. The organizer does not rent headlamps during the event.

name: Petzl Nuuksio Night Trail
description: Petzl Nuuksio Night Trail is an autumn night trail running event held on the forest trails of Nuuksio National Park in the dark. The event starts from Luukki outdoor shelter in Espoo on September 25, 2026, offering approximately a 13-kilometer route that challenges runners amidst nature. There is a dedicated category for non-binary participants, and free gear storage is available. A headlamp is a mandatory item, as the route runs through the dark forest.
course_highlights: Approximately 13 km trail run on autumn forest trails in Nuuksio
Run in the dark forest, headlamp is mandatory
Event center and start at Luukki outdoor shelter, Luukintie 33
additional: The race office is located near the start and finish, where you can pick up your race number and register late. The organizer does not rent headlamps, so participants must bring their own. Timing is done with an electronic timing app, and race numbers must be visibly attached to the chest. The maximum allowed time is 2.5 hours. Free gear storage is available on race day near the race office. Cash is not accepted, including for late registrations. The event features a 13 km trail run in the forest, with mandatory headlamp, race categories including a mixed gender series, registration and timing details, and facilities such as changing rooms, showers, sauna, and parking.

name: Punkaharjun Halkijuoksu
description: Pre-registration for the 2026 Punkaharju Halkijuoksu is now open! See more details and register to run! Alisa Vainio set a beautiful course record at the Punkaharju Halkijuoksu half marathon, which has been held 49 times.

images.alt_text: Ilmakuva metsäisestä maisemasta järven rannalla, todennäköisesti juoksureitti.

name: Rantaraitin Juoksu
description: The Rantaraitin run is held on September 27, 2025, in Kokkola, and offers runners the opportunity to choose between a 5 km or 10 km course. The start takes place on a sandy field, from where the route heads along the Rantaraitti towards Tyysterniemi. The Rantaraitti follows the coastline and is mostly well-trodden with gravel. The routes are designed to suit runners of all levels, with longer distances being more challenging.

images.alt_text: Kartta Kokkolan alueesta, mahdollisesti reitti tai tapahtuma-alue.

name: NAMI-matka
description: NAMI Trip is a running event in the Tampere region that offers a relaxed atmosphere and an encouraging environment. The event is organized by NAMI ry and has been a pleasurable running experience since 2018. Participants can choose between different distances: 100 km, 50 km, marathon, or nonstop. The route is precisely measured at 2 km, and support stations are always nearby, offering treats at each station as well as soup and coffee with accompaniments at the finish line.

name: 1. Full Moon Backyard Ultra Kymi
description: Backyard Ultra is an ultramarathon race where competitors run a 6.706-kilometer route within an hour. The race continues as long as several runners are able to complete a lap in under an hour, and the winner is the one who runs one more lap than the others. The route is either a circular loop or a back-and-forth course, and the starting area remains the same throughout the competition. There is no predetermined end time, which makes it particularly challenging and exciting. In Finland, Backyard Ultra races are organized in collaboration and the sport is actively developed.
course_highlights: The route is a 6.706 km long circular loop or back-and-forth course
Each lap starts every hour
The race continues as long as runners can complete a lap in under an hour
additional: Start announcements are given 3, 2, and 1 minute before the start. Participants must not leave the route during a lap, except for bathroom breaks. Runners must be at the starting area at the start time, and the starting area remains the same throughout the race. External assistance and aids such as poles are not allowed. Slower runners must give way to faster ones. Lap times are measured optionally. The event includes trail running on forest paths, and participants can use toilets, showers, and shelters. The start takes place at Alakyläntie 67 in Kotka, and the route is approximately 6.7 km per lap.

name: Vihteljärven ympärijuoksu - 67.
description: The Vihteljärvi Run Around is the oldest continuous annual running event in Satakunta, held since 1960. The event offers a 6.5 km run in various age groups as well as a jogging series without timing. Additionally, there are separate categories for children with shorter distances. The race takes place at Vihteljärvi School in Kankaanpää and provides participants with a traditional and communal running experience in a scenic environment.
course_highlights: 6.5 km run in multiple age groups
Children's categories on 0.2 - 1 km distances
Satakunta's oldest continuous annual running event
additional: Registration and payment on site from 10:00 AM in cash, MobilePay, or ePass. Lake circumnavigators can participate without timing starting at 10:00 AM. Children's categories start at 10:30 AM and the around-the-lake run at 12:00 PM. In competitive categories, the top three are awarded, and every participant in the children's categories receives a prize. A smart TV will be raffled among the lake circumnavigators. The event begins at Laviantie 1035 and also includes children's categories and prizes for all participants.

name: Kiehimänjoen juoksu 2026
description: The Kiehimänjoki Run is a running event held for the fifth time in Paltamo, offering a marathon, half marathon, fitness ten-kilometer run, and a children's run. The event starts on Saturday, September 26, 2026, at 11 a.m., and the race center is located at Kotolinna, where runners have access to facilities, catering, saunas, and accommodation. The routes are officially measured and timing is provided in all categories. After the run, there is an option to book a recovery massage. On-site registration is possible, but an additional fee is charged for adults.
course_highlights: Marathon 42.2 km and half marathon 21.1 km are officially measured and approved by SUL
The route has three aid stations offering sports drinks, water, raisins, and pickles
Upon finishing, showers, a sauna, a hot tub, and the possibility of a warm meal are available
additional: On-site registration for adults costs an additional 5 €. After the run, there is an option to book a 20-minute massage for 20 €. The race center at Kotolinna has changing rooms, showers, a sauna, and a hot tub. Payments at the event can be made with ePass and sport vouchers. Accommodation is available at Kotomolla, with prices excluding breakfast: single room 80 €, double room 120 €, breakfast 14 €. The event route includes city streets and possibly rural areas; registration is available online and on-site; food, sauna, and massage services are offered; multiple distances are available for runners of different levels.

name: Suojuoksun elämyskisa
description: The Running Adventure Race is a unique running event held at Ojassuo in Kauklaisten. The event offers runners the opportunity to challenge themselves and experience a different kind of running adventure in nature. The race features several routes of varying lengths suitable for both seasoned runners and beginners. Welcome to enjoy the joy of running and community!

Several routes of different lengths: 1.4 km, 2.7 km, 4.1 km, and 5.5 km
The event offers a unique running experience for both veterans and beginners
additional: Registration is on-site. The participation fee is €12 (€10 with a runner card) and includes raffle prizes and a medal. The race has categories for different route lengths, such as M-Open 5.5 km and T15 1.350 km. The event includes various running styles, such as road and trail running, but more detailed organization and participation information are not available.

name: Lampaloppet 2026
description: Lampaloppet 2026 will be held on Saturday, September 26, 2026, at Lamminaho in Pyhäjärvi. The route passes through the scenery of Honkavuori and introduces runners to the historic sites of Ahto. The event offers a suitable challenge for both goal-oriented runners and more relaxed participants. In the competitive categories, timing is provided, but there is also a non-timed fun run where participants can move at their own pace. Participants will have access to water stations, shower facilities, a sauna, and a Lampaloppet neck warmer.
course_highlights: The route passes through the scenery of Honkavuori
Introduction to the historic sites of Ahto
Water stations approximately at 5 km, 10 km, and at the finish
additional: The participation fee includes a marked route, timing in the competitive categories, water stations, shower facilities, a sauna, and a Lampaloppet neck warmer. The top three in the competitive categories will be awarded, and a Ooni pizza oven will be raffled among all participants. The fun run is a self-selected journey without timing. The event also includes the Honkavuori stair community and stair relay race, which will be held in July 2026. Participation fees vary, and the event offers opportunities for both individual and team competitions.

name: Radioaseman Ultra
description: Radioaseman Ultra Marathon (100 km) was held in Pori on September 23, 2023, at the Itä-Pori fitness trail, located at Radioasemantie 1, 28330 Pori. The route was 2 km long and ran around the old shortwave radio station of Pori. This unique ultramarathon offers runners the opportunity to test their endurance in varied terrain, where tall forests provide shelter from the wind. The race attracts participants from across the country and offers shower facilities and aid stations after the finish.

name: Säkylänharju Trail Run
description: The Säkylänharju trail run at Huovinrinteellä is held on Saturday, September 27, 2025. The routes pass through the stunning terrains of Säkylänharju, with pine forests and the majestic coves of the ridge.

The race route is relatively gently sloped and paved with asphalt, and it has been officially measured. The running route is not closed to other traffic, so participants should be alert to other vehicles. Signs, a lead car, and an emergency vehicle warn other traffic to watch out for the runners.

name: Voimaa Metsästä
description: The Voimaa Metsästä event offers races of 6-21 kilometers, and there is a separate 2 km course for children. Each course is a single, marked trail through the terrain, and no part of the route is run more than once on the same course. The routes for 2024 have undergone a thorough update, and the new event center is located at the former UKK Institute premises. All routes are primarily forest trails, with short sections of gravel roads.

description: Vihtijärvihölkkä is a traditional running event that offers participants the opportunity to compete in a half marathon, a 10-kilometer run, and shorter distances. The routes pass through varied terrain, and several water stations serve runners along the way. The event is open to different age groups and categories, and it takes place in the Vihtijärvi area. The race has been organized 58 times, indicating its popularity and tradition among locals.
course_highlights: Water stations on the half marathon route approximately every 3 - 3.5 km
Water station on the 10 km route at 5 km
Varied terrain and multiple distance and category options
additional: Race numbers must be picked up no later than 30 minutes before the start. Late registration is possible on-site up to one hour before the category start. There are several water stations along the route, and payment can also be made via MobilePay with the code 27789. Participation is free for members of Vihtijärvi Uhka in categories for 9-17-year-olds. Multiple distances, registration instructions, start times, and route information are available; outdoor terrain in the Vihtijärvi area; free participation for children aged 9-17; opportunity to purchase a participation medal after the final race.

name: Voimaa Metsästä
description: Voimaa Metsästä is a trail running and outdoor activity event in Tampere, held on September 27, 2026, at Kaupin sports park. The event offers diverse routes ranging from 2 to 21 kilometers, suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. Participation supports charity, as the proceeds are donated to Tays' new psychiatric hospital for children and adolescents. The routes are well marked and varied, providing the tranquility of nature and the joy of exercise for all participants.

The highest point in the Kauppi area, Pirunvuori, approximately 50 meters of elevation
Two aid stations along the route, guides in the terrain
additional: Participation fee includes a hot meal and refreshments at aid stations. This year, participants will also receive an event t-shirt, which can be picked up when collecting the bib. The event features a hiking series without timing for 6 and 12 km distances. Arrival is recommended by public transport or on foot/by bike, as parking facilities are limited. Registration closes 60 minutes before the start, and registration fees increase by €5 after the early registration period ends. The routes vary from 2 to 21 km, and the event raises funds for children's and adolescent psychiatry; participation and donations support Tampere's child psychiatry.

The event offers participants unique experiences in the pure Finnish nature of the beautiful Central Park.

description: Fiskars Marathon Raasepori offers beautiful gravel roads in the Uusimaa archipelago, west of Helsinki. The start is at 10:00 AM, and the race office opens at 8:30 AM. The distances and categories include 15 km, 7 km, 2 km, and 0.6 km routes, suitable for different age groups and skill levels. Calm gravel roads wind through picturesque scenery, with plenty of rest stops along the coast.

name: Komia Ilkan Polku
description: The KOMIA Ilkan Polku is being renewed! The event center is moving from Tuomikylä School to Kyrkösjärvi swimming beach in Seinäjoki and to the premises of the Nature Center Käpälikkö, which also brings changes to the routes. The main race is KOMIA Ilkan Polku 39 km, additionally there is KOMIA Ilkan relay in 4 legs, each approximately 10 km, as well as KOMIA Pikku Ilkka 20 km. A new addition is KOMIA Sprintti Ilkka 10 km and the shorter KOMIA Mini Ilkka about 2 km, offering even better opportunities to enjoy the nearby trails of Kyrkösjärvi.

name: Tampere Puolimaraton

The event route passes through the city center and along the shores of Tampere's waterways, including the shores of Lake Pyhäjärvi and the arboretum scenery. The start and finish areas are located at Tampere Stadium, which is easily accessible. The Tampere Running event is organized by Tampereen Pyrintö ry, bringing together young athletes and experienced veterans.

The starting point is Viljavarastontie 4, and the event provides a pleasant opportunity to be active and enjoy community spirit. Registration is open, and the event is organized by Loimaan Seudun Nuorkauppakamari.

Starting point Viljavarastontie 4, Loimaa
The event is held in the center of Loimaa

name: KOMIA Esi-Talvijuoksusarja
description: The KOMIA Esi-Talvijuoksusarja is a winter six-part running series that offers runners of all levels the opportunity to test and monitor their fitness development. The series routes start from Pajuluoma School and are fast and flat, offering distances of 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km. The series begins with the Esi-Talvijuoksu at the beginning of October and continues until spring. At the end of the series, the best participants are awarded, and the runs are suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

Officially verified routes in October 2024
Winter six-part running series starting in October and continuing into spring

Variety of trail and running events, registration information, series details.

name: 55. Pirkan Hölkkä 5.10.2025
description:
The running season's jewel, the cherry on top, a long-distance running event mostly on trails, is held annually on the first Sunday of October.

The 33-kilometer route from Valkeakoski to Tampere alternates between gravel paths, forest roads, and trails. The asphalt section is about five kilometers. In addition to running categories, there is an option to participate in a walking category, which does not include timing. The event is organized in cooperation with Tampereen Taivaltajat ry and Valkeakosken Retkeilijät ry.

Pirkan Hölkä has a history dating back to 1970. The route has mostly remained the same as it is today. The average number of participants in recent years has been around 1000-1500 people.
additional:
You can choose age categories Women Open, N40, N50, Men Open, M40, M50, and M60. The start takes place at Valkeakoski's Sahara field (Tallikatu 11), with the starting gun firing on Sunday morning at 9:30 AM. Late registration is available at the start area from 8 to 9 AM.

The event's timing is based on gross time, from the starting shot to crossing the finish line. At the start, you can choose a target time and a corresponding starting position near the start line.

The first 3 km of Hölkä is on city streets. The next 3 km follow a trail in the outdoor area to Leppäjärventie. After that, the route to Rutajärvi (11 km from the start) includes varied forest trails and a small section of gravel road. The 3.5 km segment between Rutajärvi and Vähä-Kausjärvi is on forest roads. The 5 km stretch from Vähä-Kausjärvi to Taivalpirtti begins on forest roads, then forest trails, and after crossing Savontie, again gravel roads.

Beyond Taivalpirtti, the route continues on varied gravel roads and forest trails around Suolijärvi. The last 3 km are on a gravel outdoor trail between Hervanta and Koivistonkylä, with some challenging climbs testing Finnish resilience.

Pirkan Hölkä's route is marked with blue fiber tape, directional arrows, and kilometer markers. The organizers aim to include as many forest trails as possible. There are six aid stations along the route.

The finish line is located in Tampere at Nirva, on the grounds of Tampere Adult Education Center (Kurssikeskuksenkatu 11). Paid bus transfers are organized from the finish area and Tampere city center to the start, available both in the morning before the start and in the afternoon after finishing. Transportation and hot lunch sold at the finish can be included in the registration fee by selecting additional services in our online store.

description: Mourunki Trailrun is a family-friendly trail running event held in Kempele at the Honkanen sports area / Pyrinnön cabin. The event starts at 9:00 AM, with children's trail runs beginning at 9:30 AM. Adults can choose from various distances, such as 40 km, 14 km, and 7 km, as well as a team competition of 3 x 14 km relay. Participants will be offered a free entry to the spring 2026 Baanarun if the 250 participant threshold is reached.

images.alt_text: Polku juoksijat metsässä, numeroilla, Mourunki TrailRun Kempele.

name: Pukinmaki Run 1/2 Maraton 10k 5k
description: Pukinmäki Run is an annual running event held in the Pukinmäki district of Helsinki. The officially measured race distances are 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon, as well as a 1 km race for children. The running route circles the borders of Pukinmäki on flat terrain, running along outdoor paths, of which about 85% are asphalt. The route is fast with only 4.9 meters of elevation change, making it suitable for all runners.
course_highlights: Officially measured distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and 1 km for children
Flat terrain with only 4.9 meters of elevation change
Approximately 85% of the route is on asphalt
Fast course suitable for all runners

name: Köykkyri NUTS
description: NUTS Köykkyri is a relaxed yet brisk trail running event where participants challenge the Köykkyrin hill and enjoy good company. Expect hill training, sweating, and a pre-Christmas party atmosphere with a run-elf theme! Experience Kempele's "high-altitude" thrill and feel the true excitement of mountain running with a 25-meter elevation gain. Get ready to dash to Kempele's "summit," where every ascent is a celebration and every descent deserves applause.

name: Lepokallion Lenkki Polkujuoksu
description: Lepokallion lenkki – trail running race takes place in Ylistaro on Saturday, November 2nd at 11:00 AM. The event offers varied terrain in beautiful scenery, including trails and natural areas, providing runners with stunning views and challenges. The route has several different distances, including 5.6 kilometers and 10.8 kilometers, suitable for both beginners and more experienced runners.

name: Sarvilahden Maraton
description: The Sarvilahden Marathon will be held on October 25, 2025, in Rauhala Park, Loviisa. The event features several categories, including the marathon, half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km, as well as a 1.6 km children's route. The marathon is run on an officially measured half marathon distance twice. Parking is available at the Loviisa Ice Hall, approximately 400 meters from the start area in the park.

images.alt_text: Ryhmä juoksijoita juoksee kilpailussa, jossa on numeroituja kilpailijoita.

name: Helsinki Halloween Run
description: Helsinki Halloween Run is a fun Halloween-themed running event suitable for runners of all levels. In 2025, the event will be held on October 25th in Kalasatama, Helsinki! The new route takes place in the urban environment of Kalasatama and consists of a 5 km loop, run once for the 5 km race and twice for the 10 km race. You can participate competitively against the clock or dressed in your most frightening Halloween costume.
course_highlights: Event date: October 25, 2025
Location: Kalasatama, Helsinki
Route: Urban environment with a 5 km loop
Race distances: 5 km and 10 km
Participation options: Competitive or costume run

name: Tuusula Trailrun
description: Tuusula Trailrun 2024 is a trail running event held on Sunday, October 27, 2024, at 11:00 AM at the Tuusula Sports Center shooting ski stadium. The race course loops through the trails of Korpikylä and Sammalojan in Tuusula, marked with blue and white ribbons and signs. The participation fee includes trail running, timing (chip), warm soup and drinks, and a shower opportunity at the ice hall.

images.alt_text: Ryhmä juoksijoita juoksemassa asfaltilla, metsä taustalla.

name: Hiidenhölkkä Nummela
description: As autumn approaches, so does the traditional Hiidenhölkkä, which will be held this year for the 47th time by Nummelan Tarmo. The routes for Hiidenhölkkä 10 km and 20 km (2x10 km) loops circle Nummelanharju and Nummela Airport. The start of Hiidenhölkkä is at 12:00 PM, and the running event will end at 2:00 PM.
course_highlights: Routes include 10 km and 20 km (2x10 km) loops
Circles Nummelanharju and Nummela Airport
Start at 12:00 PM
Event ends at 2:00 PM

name: Rantasaunan Lenkki
description: Rantasaunan Lenkki and Osmojuoksut are held on Friday, June 8th. Osmo-juoksut start at 6:00 PM, and runners are grouped by age. After registration, runners are divided into suitable heats, and numbers are distributed around 6:00 PM. The Hitrekki run begins at 7:30 PM, and prizes are awarded after the races, including a prize donated by Key Savings Bank and ice cream for all participants.

images.alt_text: Juoksija maalissa kohottaa nyrkkiä ja hymyilee.

name: Järvenpään Maraton
description: Järvenpään Maraton has been held since 1994. The half marathon and marathon routes are officially measured, mainly running around Lake Tuusula on a paved light traffic route. For the first time, the route passes along Tuusula's Rantatie and offers cultural experiences for both runners and spectators. The area has excellent transportation connections and enough parking space nearby. Welcome to Tuusula and Järvenpää!

name: Itsenäisyysmaraton
description: The Independence Marathon celebrates its 44th anniversary in 2025 and will be held on Saturday, December 6th, in Kuopio, Väinölänniemi. The race offers several different distances, including a marathon, half marathon, mini marathon, and the Kultajousi Running series of 10 km and 5 km. The route is 5.27 km long, sandy and asphalt-based, a flat running course with aid stations providing water and juice for runners. Participants can register in advance or on the day of the race.

name: Backyardish Ultra
description: Backyardish Ultra Kuopio mimics traditional backyard ultra, but is not an official backyard ultra. The route is a marked forest loop of approximately 6.7 kilometers, and the event takes place in Neulamäki on Saturday, November 16, 2024, from 9 AM to 9 PM. All participants start the first lap at 9 AM, and laps begin every hour on the hour. The winner is the one who crosses the finish line first on the last lap, and there is no winner if no one is able to complete the final lap.

images.alt_text: Metsässä juoksevia ihmisiä polulla, juoksukilpailuun liittyvä kuva.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 2/5
description: Finland's largest road running series, Vantaa Road Running Cup, begins again on Saturday at Sotunki School, which is the competition center after a few years' break. The event has a 32-year history, and this year the main sponsor is MK FACADE OY. On Saturday, races will be held on 5 km and 10 km distances, with starts at 13:00 and 13:10. The route is designed to provide runners with a pleasant and safe environment, and enhanced supervision ensures safety during the competition.

images.alt_text: Juoksukilpailu Vantaalla, jossa joukko ihmisiä juoksee asfaltilla. Taustalla rakennuksia ja puita.

name: Talvisarjajuoksu Rovaniemi
description: The traditional RDS Winter Race Series is starting again! The first event will be held on Saturday, October 4th at 11:00 AM on the familiar and safe Koskenkylä route. The third event of the Winter Race Series will take place on Saturday, December 13, 2025, at 11:00 AM on the Koskenkylä course. As a new addition, there will be an open 2 km fitness series for everyone.

name: Teivocup II
description: Teivocup is a winter season test running series that offers the opportunity to participate in running competitions at various levels, from amateurs to competitive runners. The event is held in Ylöjärvi near the Teivo racecourse and is aimed at all endurance sports enthusiasts. Each race distance is 5 km, and registration is on-site. The participation fee is €10 per race (€7 for club members). The second race will be held on Saturday, December 13, 2025, followed by a Christmas party for members at Lamminpää cabin.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu
description: Forssan Puistojuoksu is an event that promotes fitness for the entire city and has been attracting runners for 30 years. The monthly race features always 100-200 runners of various ages, and the beautiful route winds through the scenery of the Loimijoki river. Runners start on either the 5.8 km or 11.2 km long course, which runs along the outskirts of Forssa's city center in the park of the old cotton mill. The start and finish are located on Keskuskatu, in front of the over-a-hundred-year-old Elävät kuvat cinema.

name: Buugin Pamaus Juoksu
description: Welcome to the first-ever Good Mood New Year's Run at Buugi Sports Center on December 31, 2024, at 6:00 PM! The event is organized in collaboration between Buugi Sports Center and Hippoksen Marathon Club, aiming to be the best way to start the New Year in Central Finland with good company through running and a buffet meal. Participants can choose a 10 km course in competitive and recreational categories for women and men.

images.alt_text: Juoksija punaisella juoksuradalla. Hyvän mielen uuden vuoden juoksu.

description: New Year's Run is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy exercise on New Year's Eve. The event takes place on December 31, 2024, in various locations such as Seinäjoki, Liminka, Lieto, and Imatra, offering participants a variety of routes suitable for different ages and skill levels. The routes are officially measured and safe, with traffic control in place. The event brings together running enthusiasts and also provides an opportunity to enjoy coffee and refreshments from local kiosks.

name: Talvijuoksu Lappeenranta
description: The Winter Running Series is a winter running event held in Lappeenranta. The event starts and ends next to the Pallon Sports Hall at Tukkikatu 2. Registration takes place at the starting point 20 minutes before the start, and there are different distances available: 3 km, 5 km, and 7 km. For children, there is approximately a 1 km course, and all routes run along illuminated bike paths in a back-and-forth course. The event is free and open to everyone, with a temperature limit of -15°C.

name: Talvijuoksusarja 3/6
description: The Winter Running Series, 3rd event, will be held on December 30, 2023, in Mikkeli, offering runners the opportunity to participate in various distances such as 10 km and 6 km. The event is specially designed for winter conditions and attracts both competitive and recreational runners. Previous races have seen excellent performances, and participants can enjoy the winter running atmosphere.

Runners start and finish on Keskuskatu, in front of the over 100-year-old Elävät kuvat cinema.

name: Teivocup III 2027
description: Teivocup III 2027 is a six-part training competition and test run series held once a month from November to April. The event offers running opportunities for different age and category groups, with distances of 5 km and 2 km. The route runs along a light traffic lane, with start and finish located at the intersection of Teivo Race Center. Registration takes place at Lamminpään Outdoor Hut, and the race starts at 12:00 PM. The best runners will be awarded.

Start and finish at the intersection of Teivo Race Center

name: Teivocup IV 2027
description: Teivocup IV 2027 is a six-part training and test race series held once a month from November to April. The fourth event of the series will take place on February 6 at Lamminpää Outdoor Cabin in Ylöjärvi. The series includes several distances for different age and category groups, and the route runs along a light traffic route near the Teivo racecourse intersection. Registration takes place on-site no later than 11:30 AM, and the start is at 12:00 PM. The best runners will be awarded.

name: LAPONIE Boreal Winter-Trail Trail To Be Alive
description: Laponie Boreal Winter-Trail is a unique winter adventure in Inari, offering participants the chance to experience Arctic nature and the Northern Lights. This winter trail running event takes runners to stunning landscapes in the Lapland wilderness, providing unforgettable experiences amidst nature. The event is part of the Trail to Be Alive series, known for its high-quality and adventurous trail races around the world. Runners can expect a challenging yet rewarding course that combines the tranquility of nature and the beauty of winter.

Opportunity to see the Northern Lights
Challenging trail running route amidst nature
additional: The event is part of an international trail tour, but more detailed information about the course or registration is not available.

name: Teivocup V 2027
description: Teivocup V is a winter test running competition series held around Teivo Racecourse from November to April once a month. The race covers a 5-kilometer route and is open to runners of all levels, from amateurs to competitive athletes. Registration takes place on-site at least one hour before the start, and the participation fee is 10 euros per event, 7 euros for club members. The series includes men's and women's categories as well as a community competition.

Winter competition series from November to April
Suitable for runners of all levels, from amateurs to competitive athletes

The event offers an opportunity to participate in a 5 km run and join the Finnish running community. Participation fees and further details are not currently available.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 4/5
description: Vantaa Road Running Cup is Finland's largest and fastest winter running series, offering low-threshold road running competitions in Hakunila, Vantaa. The series consists of five events, featuring 5 km and 10 km distances. The races attract a wide range of participants and are officially measured on courses run in sunny spring weather. By purchasing a series pass, participants can easily take part in all events without separate registration each time. The event is traditional and also offers opportunities for running schools and coaching.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses in Hakunila, Vantaa
Fast and high-quality winter running competitions
Held in sunny spring weather and attracting a large number of participants

Exact event details and results are available; there is no direct mention of the price or specific features of the course.

name: Komian kirkon hölkkä
description: Komian Kirkon run / jog is a running event organized by Ylistaron Kilpa-Veljet ry in the Ylistaro area. The competition offers a variety of routes, such as 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon, which pass through beautiful landscapes and offer diverse scenery. The event is popular among locals and provides a good opportunity to test fitness at the beginning of spring. The race is part of Ylistaron Kilpa-Veljet ry's active event calendar and orienteering activities.

Beautiful and diverse terrains in the Ylistaro area
Route maps available for 5 km and half marathon/10 km routes
additional: Race instructions for runners, supporters, guardians, and volunteers can be found on the race info page. Results service and registered participants are accessible online. Route maps for the race are available in PDF format for the 5 km and half marathon/10 km routes. The event will be held on April 4, 2027, and includes various competition and participation opportunities. Race results and additional information are available on the event's website.

name: Arctic Marathon
description: Arctic Marathon offers a unique running experience in the stunning landscapes of Finnish Lapland. Participants can choose from a marathon, half marathon, or 10 km race, all passing through arctic nature. Participants stay in four-star Finnish cottages with a sauna, enjoy full board, and partake in various activities such as husky safaris, ice swimming, and viewing the Northern Lights. The event combines sport and adventure in a unique way and is part of the international Wildmarathon series.
course_highlights: 42 km marathon route in the natural landscape of Finnish Lapland
Option to run a 21 km half marathon or 10 km race
The route passes through arctic environments where the Northern Lights can be seen
additional: The event includes airport transfers from Rovaniemi to Santa Claus Holiday Village, accommodation in 4* cottages with saunas, all meals, awards ceremony, husky safari, ice swimming, and the opportunity to see the Northern Lights. The program also features post-run sauna and cooling activities as well as relaxation. The race starts from Santa Claus Holiday Village. Terrain includes snow roads and forest tracks, temperatures range from -12°C to -7°C, recommended gear includes spikes and thermal clothing, registration covers accommodations, meals, transfers, and Arctic experiences.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 5/5
description: Vantaa Road Running Cup is Finland's largest and fastest winter running series, consisting of five events in Hakunila and Tikkurila, Vantaa. The competitions offer low-threshold road running races, where participants can join either with a series pass or a one-time fee. The route runs around Sotunki High School, which also serves as the competition center. In the final event of the series, the best performers in each category are awarded based on points, and runners are also encouraged with bonuses paid for record-breaking course times. The event is open to runners of all levels, and there is also a running school with coaching.
course_highlights: The route runs around Sotunki High School in Vantaa
The competition center is Sotunki High School, with changing rooms and shower facilities
At the finish area, sports drinks and a café are offered
additional: By purchasing a series pass, participants can take part in all five events without separate registration. Race numbers are collected from the race office and returned after each race. Prizes are awarded after the final event based on points, and participants must compete in at least two events to be eligible for overall prizes. The running school offers coaching and training for runners, and members can participate in the road running cup for free by purchasing a pass in advance. The event is held in Tikkurila, Vantaa, and includes several races such as the Five and the Ten. These competitions are popular local events that provide an opportunity to participate in low-threshold road races.

name: Valio Helsinki City Run
description: Valio Helsinki City Run is Finland's largest running event, bringing together over 24,000 runners from more than 110 countries to Helsinki's Olympic Stadium and city streets. The event offers six different race distances, including a marathon, half marathon, marathon relay, 5 km run and walk, as well as a children's Minimarathon. The routes are beautiful and maritime, with the finish line located at the Olympic Stadium. The event also provides comprehensive services such as international-standard timing, aid stations, and free entry to the Swimming Stadium after the run.
course_highlights: Beautiful and maritime routes in Helsinki
Finish line and event center at the Olympic Stadium
Officially measured AIMS-certified routes
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the Olympic Stadium before the race, with the option to pay using sports benefits (ePassi, Edenred, Zevoy Benefits). Group registration requires at least 5 runners, and groups of 10 or more receive free event shirts. Free entry to the Swimming Stadium after the run is included, along with aid stations and gels along the route. Participants can purchase cancellation insurance, and there are free joint training sessions and training programs. The event features international-standard timing (excluding walking). Multiple race categories are available, including marathon, half marathon, 5 km run, and walk events. Participants can follow real-time results and download diplomas immediately after finishing. The event takes place at the Olympic Stadium and includes a week of activities and sponsorship opportunities.

name: RAHOLAN KYMPPI (TAMPERE)
location: Tampereen Tesoman jäähallin parkkipaikka, Tampere, Pirkanmaa, Finland
description: Rahola Ten is an annual 10-kilometer running event starting from the parking lot of Tampere Tesoma Ice Hall. It offers runners the opportunity to enjoy a route that is traditional and popular among locals. The event is part of Team Rahola's running calendar and attracts a diverse group of participants. The run is a good opportunity to test fitness during the spring and experience community spirit at a running event.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer route
Start and finish at Tampere Tesoma Ice Hall parking lot
Traditional and popular local running event
additional: Team Rahola's Monday community runs from the Tesoma Ice Hall at 18:00 offer training opportunities. There are no specific start times or price information mentioned for the running event. Team Rahola also offers other running events and training sessions, such as the Cooper test and weekly gatherings. The event takes place at the parking lot of Tampere Tesoma Ice Hall, and participants can run or walk. The competition provides an opportunity to enjoy exercise in an environment that combines nature and the city.

name: Kaldoaivi Ultra Trail
description: Kaldoaivi Ultra Trail is the northernmost ultramarathon event in the world, held in Utsjoki, in the wilderness of Lapland. The route passes over the peaks of the highest fells in Kaldoaivi and offers stunning, challenging scenery. The race tests runners' endurance and skills in demanding natural conditions, but rewards experience that makes many return annually. The event also includes mountain biking competitions and offers diverse options for participants of different levels.
course_highlights: The route passes over the peaks of the highest fells in Kaldoaivi
Beautiful and rugged Lapland wilderness scenery
Challenging and educational trail route
additional: Registration for two days grants a 30% discount on the cheaper series price. The participation fee includes drinks and energy supplies at aid stations, shower facilities, transportation of gear bags to the finish, a start number, timing chip, Kaldoaivi Ultra Trail lightweight backpack, KUT product, and a Finisher pendant. Series changes and transfers are free until July 7, 2027. Competition centers and start locations are in Nuorgam and Utsjoki. The race schedule includes multiple start times for different distances on July 23 and 24, 2027. Participant quotas vary by distance, for example, MTB & E-MTB 57 km: 100 participants, Trailrun 168 km: 100 participants. The event includes several disciplines such as trail running, mountain biking, and road cycling, without amenities along the route. Participation includes a race number, timing chip, lightweight backpack, and finisher pendant. The event takes place in July 2027, with detailed schedules and registration information available on the website.

name: Nevas Night Run
description: Nevas Night Run 2026 event will be held on September 4, 2026, at Kalkkiranta in Sipoo. This running event offers participants the opportunity to choose from different distances, which are 12.5 km and 7 km. The longer distance includes two laps around Byträsket, while the shorter distance is designed for all runners. The renewed event also features new categories, and the start location has changed, bringing new challenges and experiences for participants.

description: The Vaasa Marathon will be held on September 6, 2025, at Kaarlen Field on Ruutikellarintie in Vaasa. The race start times are scheduled for different groups, and the last lap must start by 3:00 PM. Participants can choose to run the marathon, half marathon, 10.5 km distance, or the Minimarathon, which is free for children.

Last lap start deadline at 3:00 PM

name: Masters Athletics Marathon
description: Masters Marathon - Runners can once again compete with the world's best athletes in their own age group. WMA is excited to announce that RunInBucharest has accepted the challenge to host the World Championships for Masters athletes in 2024. The 2024 World Masters Athletics Marathon Championship will be run on October 13th alongside the Bucharest Marathon, offering a wonderful opportunity to enjoy running in a beautiful environment, with the course passing by the city's main landmarks.

The race is held in Nuuksio National Park and attracts runners from Finland and around the world. Participants can choose from different distances, such as 42 km and 70 km, and enjoy perfect routes, wild forests, and excellent organization. Welcome to join on September 5, 2026!

Excellent organization

name: Orimattilan Kymppi
description: The most significant village event developed in Kuivanto is Kuivannon Kymppi, which as an active celebration brings the villagers together in late autumn to exercise and organize a sports event. This outdoor and sports event, initiated by the villagers, was held for the first time in 1981, when 24 fitness enthusiasts completed the route. The event has grown into a significant international event, with over 500 participants from different countries such as Russia, Estonia, Sweden, England, and Kenya. Through collaboration between the city of Orimattila and local village associations, the event has been developed on the principle of 'year by year'.
